youtube_title: Neck Pain From Your Phone? Your Head Gets 'heavier' | Body Fix #36 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #36. 6 hours a day, head bent over your phone... and now your NECK hurts?
B is right. Lift the phone to EYE LEVEL. The more you bend, the more load.
Head forward = neck muscles work much harder, for hours a day.
Fix: Phone up, chin tucks, scroll breaks, no scrolling lying on your front.
Red flags: Pain into arms, tingling, weak grip, or worsening? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Cleveland Clinic - text neck
